This is the dimension of the space in which a Gale diagram of the configuration lives; for the vertex set of a $d$-polytope with $n$ vertices, Gale diagrams are low-dimensional exactly when $n$ is close to $d$. nodes.summary: Let $v_1, \dots, v_n$ be points in a real vector space and let $b_1, \dots, b_r$ be a basis of their space of affine dependences. The Gale transform sends the index $i$ to the $i$-th row of the $n \times r$ matrix whose columns are the basis vectors.
